fixture_origins.reason: Original copied fixture contains 12 wallet files; requested wallets 16, 20, 24 and 28 were absent. No GPU worker started.

limitations: This qualifies two three-job sequences through the existing native public worker protocol, using a single-entry preprocessing cache. It does not qualify simultaneous retention of multiple preprocessing keys or a return to an evicted key.
Policy context is installed through ProcessWorker.replace_context after startup, as used by the pool adapter. Bootstrap remains empty-policy and retains its 64 KiB ceiling.
The production static library and C worker are identical to section 9.160. Only the ignored native test harness and its test helpers changed.

The final context-protocol correction changes only the research-gated mixed test module. Standard builds/tests cover unchanged shared helper code from the preceding source snapshot; final research builds/tests use the corrected source.
Roots reuse archived pair and merge proofs. These are native proof-job/cache-lifetime measurements, not durably applied user transactions, matched throughput comparisons, or a full live pool DAG.

Observed resource limits, private-data/spill/staging/stack partitions and cleanup do not establish complete process mapping, driver, kernel or scheduler phase-lifetime admission. Ordinary incomplete profiles remain inadmissible.

All maintained routes, full live pool workloads, matched delivered-throughput versus hybrid comparisons, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64 cold <=600 s, post-seal application <=180 s, depth 6/root <=2 MiB gates, multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and pending Apple integration remain open.
